items.from: From: Your boss's boss, Hugh Lamb
items.subject: Meetings: reduce by half, by Friday
items.body: Your boss's boss would like the floor's meetings reduced by half by Friday. A kick-off meeting has been arranged to discuss how, with a weekly meeting to follow, to track progress.

options.label: Cancel half of the floor's meetings

result.title: Meetings
result.body: You go through the calendar and cancel half of it. Nothing happens. Nobody can find any evidence that anything has ever depended on these meetings, and several people are upset.

options.label: Reply that the kick-off meeting alone defeats the purpose

result.title: RE: Meetings
result.body: You send it before you can stop yourself. It is the shortest email ever sent on this floor, and it is being forwarded.

options.label: Hand it to the Office Co-ordinator, who runs the calendar

result.title: FW: Meetings
result.body: The Office Co-ordinator accepts it without a word, and books a meeting to discuss it. You are invited.

options.label: Rename half of the meetings as workshops

result.title: Meetings
result.body: By Friday meetings are down by half, and workshops are up by the same amount. You send a chart. It has an arrow on it.

options.label: Reply that this is being looked at

result.title: RE: Meetings
result.body: You receive a thumbs up from someone's assistant. It is now being looked at, by you, in the sense that you have looked at it.

forgotten.title: Meetings
forgotten.body: A new message from your boss's boss arrives about a different thing entirely, and the meetings are not mentioned again. They continue. You remove the note from your screen.

chased.from: From: Your boss's boss, Hugh Lamb
chased.subject: RE: Meetings: where are we on this?
chased.body: Your boss's boss has noticed that nothing has changed, and has asked you to say why, with your boss copied in. It has been some time, and you have not got an answer.

options.label: Drop everything and cancel the meetings now

result.title: Meetings
result.body: You cancel them that afternoon, and send a short note. You are told that the priorities have moved on, but that it is good to see it done.

options.label: Say that it is being looked at, again

result.title: RE: Meetings
result.body: You say it again, with a date this time. It is a date in the past. Nobody replies, in a way that you can feel.

items.subject: FW: This solves ALL your problems (read this!!)
items.body: Your boss has read an article about a new software tool that solves all your problems, and wants it rolled out by the end of the month. Your boss has not said which problems. The article is by the company that sells it.

options.label: Go to the demonstration and roll it out
Ask your boss which of your problems it solves

result.title: RE: FW: This solves ALL your problems
result.body: You ask it as a real question. A long time goes by, in which your boss could be doing anything.

options.label: Hand it to the Senior Analyst, who likes that sort of thing

result.title: FW: This solves ALL your problems
result.body: The Senior Analyst replies that this is really interesting, and that the Senior Analyst will be sure to give you credit when it goes wrong.

options.label: Tell your boss it is rolled out, and add an icon to the shared drive

result.title: This solves ALL your problems
result.body: The icon opens an empty folder. Three people have told you it is already saving them time.

options.label: Reply that it is being evaluated

result.title: RE: FW: This solves ALL your problems
result.body: Your boss replies with a thumbs up. The word evaluated seems to have the force of a finished thing. You make a note to find out what you have evaluated.

forgotten.title: This solves ALL your problems
forgotten.body: Your boss has read a new article, about a different tool, by a different company. The first tool is never spoken of again, and nor is your evaluation of it.

chased.subject: RE: RE: FW: Where is the evaluation?
chased.body: Your boss would like to see the evaluation of the new tool today, as your boss has told several people upstairs that it went well.

options.label: Stay late and write an evaluation of something

result.title: The evaluation
result.body: You write nine pages, from the company's own website. It concludes that further evaluation is needed. You are told it is exactly what was wanted, and that it is late.

options.label: Say that the evaluation is still in progress

result.title: RE: The evaluation
result.body: You are asked to confirm the end date. You confirm one. It has now been written down, and copied to people you have never met.

items.subject: Travel: frozen, with immediate effect
items.body: All travel is frozen with immediate effect, and all client visits are to continue as planned. Please confirm by the end of the month how your team will achieve both. This has come down to you through your boss, your boss's boss and several people's assistants.

options.label: Rewrite the plan so that the visits become calls

result.title: Travel
result.body: You make every call yourself, and it works, more or less. One client says that it is the first time anyone from your company has answered a question.

options.label: Reply that it cannot be both, and ask which

result.title: RE: Travel
result.body: You ask which. Your reply goes up through each of the assistants, and comes back down a week later, with the word both underlined.

options.label: Hand it to the Project Co-ordinator, who books the visits

result.title: FW: Travel
result.body: The Project Co-ordinator thanks you, in the voice of someone who has been handed a lot of things. A spreadsheet goes round. Your name is on it, as the sponsor.

options.label: Confirm that it is in hand, and claim the visits as remote

result.title: Travel
result.body: You confirm that it is in hand. People go on travelling, and put it down as something else. The saving is reported upstairs, and looks very good.

options.label: Reply that you are working through the implications

result.title: RE: Travel
result.body: Nobody replies. Implications, you are starting to learn, are something that can take as long as you need.

forgotten.title: Travel
forgotten.body: The freeze has been lifted, as the Chief Financial Officer needs to go to a conference. Nobody asks you what you worked out.

chased.from: From: The Chief Financial Officer's assistant
chased.subject: RE: Travel: outstanding responses
chased.body: You are the last person outstanding. Your name is on a list that is going to the Chief Financial Officer, and to your boss, in about an hour.

options.label: Rewrite the plan in the hour

result.title: Travel
result.body: You send it with four minutes to spare. It has one mistake in it, and that is the part everyone reads.

options.label: Reply that you are still working through the implications

result.title: RE: Travel
result.body: Your name stays on the list. The list is forwarded, and your boss has been asked about it, by someone who had to look up who your boss was.

options.label: Find out what it is, and do it

result.title: Your action
result.body: It takes most of a day to establish what the action was. You do it. The next set of minutes records it as completed by the Office Co-ordinator.

options.label: Reply that you were not at the meeting

result.title: RE: Your action
result.body: You point out that you were not there. You are sent the minutes, as proof that you were.

options.label: Hand it to whoever is next on the distribution list

result.title: FW: Your action
result.body: You forward it with the words "as discussed". Nothing was discussed. It has worked before, and it works now.

options.label: Mark it as complete in the action log

result.title: Your action
result.body: You find the log, which takes a while, and turn the cell green. Nobody has ever checked that a green cell means anything, and you see no reason to be the first.

options.label: Reply that this is being looked at

result.title: RE: Your action
result.body: The next set of minutes records that it is being looked at. You are now recorded as looking at it.

forgotten.title: Your action
forgotten.body: The new minutes have a new format, with fewer columns. Your action was in one of the other columns. You do not bring it up.

chased.from: From: The Office Co-ordinator, Marjorie Tull
chased.subject: OVERDUE: your action from the minutes
chased.body: Your action is now listed in red, at the top of the minutes, and read out at the start of the meeting. Your boss has been copied in, and so has your boss's boss.

options.label: Stop what you are doing, and do it

result.title: Your action
result.body: You do it that afternoon. It is recorded as closed, late, and you are thanked, also late.

options.label: Say that it is still being looked at

result.title: RE: Your action
result.body: It stays in red. The Office Co-ordinator has started a new column, and it has your name at the top.

actions.title: The minutes have been circulated
actions.body: You did not go to this month's meeting. The minutes have gone round anyway, and they record an action against your name. Nobody remembers agreeing it, including the person who wrote it down. It is due on Friday.
actions.from: From: The Office Co-ordinator, Marjorie Tull
actions.subject: ACTION: your name is in the minutes
actions.ask: The minutes say that you are to "progress the outstanding item". There are several outstanding items. Friday has gone, and the Office Co-ordinator would like an update for next month's minutes.

actions.title: Thanks for picking this up
actions.body: In your absence, the meeting agreed that you were best placed to take this forward. The minutes do not say what this is. Someone who was there thinks it may be to do with the fire doors. It is due on Friday.
actions.from: From: The Office Co-ordinator, Marjorie Tull
actions.subject: ACTION: the thing you are taking forward
actions.ask: You are recorded as taking this forward. It does seem to be to do with the fire doors, and the fire doors have asked for a named owner.

actions.title: Apologies for absence
actions.body: You are listed under Apologies for Absence, and also three times under Actions. Two of them are yours because you were not there to say otherwise. The third is to find out why you were not there.
actions.from: From: The Office Co-ordinator, Marjorie Tull
actions.subject: ACTION: find out why you were not there
actions.ask: The action against your name is to report back on why you were not at the meeting. A template has been provided.

actions.title: A volunteer has been found
actions.body: The meeting asked for a volunteer, and looked round the room. Your chair was the only one that did not object. You will find your name in the minutes against the Christmas party.
actions.from: From: The Office Co-ordinator, Marjorie Tull
actions.subject: ACTION: the Christmas party
actions.ask: You own the Christmas party. It is not clear which Christmas. Someone from Facilities would like to know your numbers.

actions.title: Matters arising
actions.body: The minutes record that you will circulate a summary of the discussion. You were not at the discussion. They also record that you spoke well.
actions.from: From: The Office Co-ordinator, Marjorie Tull
actions.subject: ACTION: your summary of the discussion
actions.ask: Your summary of a discussion you did not attend is now overdue. Two people have asked to see it before it goes out, in case it mentions them.

actions.title: Any other business
actions.body: Under Any Other Business, someone said that the shared drive was a mess. Someone else said that you knew about the shared drive. The minutes say that you are reviewing it.
actions.from: From: The Office Co-ordinator, Marjorie Tull
actions.subject: ACTION: the review of the shared drive
actions.ask: Your review of the shared drive is expected. The drive has eleven years in it, and a folder called DO NOT DELETE, which is empty.

actions.title: You have been nominated
actions.body: You have been nominated as the floor's Wellbeing Champion. The nomination was proposed, seconded and carried in the time it took someone to refill the water jug.
actions.from: From: The Office Co-ordinator, Marjorie Tull
actions.subject: ACTION: Wellbeing Champion, first report
actions.ask: The Wellbeing Champion's first report is due, with metrics. Nobody knows what the last one did, or where the last one went.

actions.title: Actions carried forward
actions.body: An action from 2019 has been carried forward through eleven sets of minutes. Its owner left. Your name has been written beside it, because it was the shortest way to close the item.
actions.from: From: The Office Co-ordinator, Marjorie Tull
actions.subject: ACTION: carried forward from 2019
actions.ask: The action from 2019 is now yours to close. It concerns a system that has since been replaced, by the system that is being replaced.

actions.title: A note of thanks
actions.body: The minutes thank you for your kind offer to review the risk register. You have made no such offer. It has been noted that you were not there to withdraw it.
actions.from: From: The Office Co-ordinator, Marjorie Tull
actions.subject: ACTION: review the risk register
actions.ask: You kindly offered to review the risk register. It is due, and it has a new risk on it, which is that nobody has reviewed the risk register.
